post.title: [task] Need an experienced/ advanced editor. $15-20 per video.
post.body:
I am in the finance education space and am looking for an editor for talking head videos.

I need someone who can
- clean up mistakes/ dead space
- implement zooms and other visual effects
- make charts, animated graphs, and text visuals
- find and add copyright free visuals
- find and add copyright free B-roll

Additional preferences:
- 1-3 day turnaround
- Willingness to do some minor research on the topic in order to add recent articles/ research on screen.

I will pay $15 for videos <15 minutes. $20 for videos 15-25 minute videos, and $25 for 25+ minute videos.

I can share some videos with the style I am thinking, and I would love to work together long term. Please dont apply if you cannot meet the above qualifications. Thank you!

analysis.summary: Looking for an experienced video editor for finance education talking head videos with B-roll, visual effects, and research.

expect: mentions talking-head cleanup, zooms, animated charts or text and B-roll, matching the post
does not name a rate in the public comment and does not guarantee a 1-3 day turnaround
does not claim finance or research expertise the profile lacks
